reading_rule: Complete selected scientific source values, with custody-only fields removed as documented. Author-state tokens remain dated source history; original later qualification governs scientific acceptance.

common_contract.population: Only six explicit directions. Candidate enumeration, native labels and finite-control PASS do not classify other pairs.
common_contract.partial_input: A scoped actual input can support, contradict, qualify or expose uncertainty in a receiving premise before the entire receiver, current intent state or commitment decision is complete. A material result need not cause a final action flip. A passing check does not authorize a requirement change or prove intended-use fitness.
common_contract.application_distinctions: Known operative input already satisfied by an adequate incumbent is different from no relevant consumer; unknown correspondence is different from established absence. Proposed, governing, implemented, observed and verified are different statuses. A failed necessary same-scoped premise remains a contradiction while other conditions are unknown.
common_contract.source_scope: Native P001/P002/P004 complete fresh B33 reading; EA06 complete own prior reading retained after exact identity checks. The eight new source reads are complete selected metadata/access records, not fresh primary bodies. Historical/analytical accounts, a single-site case and standards metadata have different evidential roles.
common_contract.finite_scope: C24 newly executes criterion interpretation over two exact earlier C22 observations. Twelve cases and eighteen assertions are not twelve behavior experiments. Authority/status, purpose and correspondence are declared inputs; no old scientific program is executed or imported, and no directional verdict is generated by the control.
common_contract.cost_and_authority: Use a short owned example, current result, ordinary version identity or adequate analysis/manual check where sufficient. Charge acquiring representative evidence, maintaining oracles/requirements, stakeholder clarification and change coordination. Economic tailoring does not create authority or waive an actual binding duty.
common_contract.reverse_rule: The reverse source supplies a different premise and has its own guard, alternatives and contrary witness. Sharing a behavior or document does not establish symmetry, transitivity or whole-property satisfaction.

directions.shared_object: A particular requirement or intent item and its claimed implemented/verified behavior for a named configuration.
directions.guard: An actual intent/requirements inquiry consumes a credible EA06 observation or exposed coverage limit for that identified behavior when maintaining the item's status, rationale or proposed revision. The observation-to-item correspondence is established at the claimed scope; overall requirements completeness, agreement and final change approval can remain unresolved.
directions.source_contribution: A repeatable result supplies limited support, a contrary sample or a coverage gap for the item's implementation/verification status. A mismatch can initiate a defect-versus-intent inquiry; it does not by itself decide whether the code or requirement ought to change.
directions.receiving_consequence: P001's living state can distinguish what is proposed, operative, implemented and actually supported, instead of treating an old approved statement or green badge as current truth. Useful evidence can be recorded before the responsible owner settles all other needs or changes.
directions.remaining_premises: Actual need and owner; correct operative version/status; trustworthy oracle and artifact correspondence; other conditions and stakeholder acceptance; a legitimate revision path. Evidence producers cannot approve their own proposed intent change merely by editing expected values.
directions.positive_witness: C24 reuses the actual ordinary observation3. Against declared current R1 expected3 it supplies local support despite unresolved actual_user_need. Against explicitly approved successor R2 expected2 it contradicts that sample requirement. Those are two declared intent contexts applied to one old observation, not two new executions or discovered requirements.
directions.stronger_claim_counterexample: A test owner changes the oracle from2 to observed3 and declares the requirement satisfied without an authorized intent revision. Raw self-matching equality can be green while C24 rejects the supplied oracle as different from the named current criterion. Even correct conformance does not establish that the requirement expresses the right user need.
directions.nontrigger: No actual requirement/intent item consumes this evidence, or the check only formats the requirement document. Unknown item correspondence is not established absence. An already current directly owned example can satisfy the input without a new requirements platform.
directions.cheap_alternative_and_cost: Retain the needed sample and exact version link in a small existing item; use adequate inspection/analysis/manual confirmation if automation adds no value. Avoid duplicate trace stores and exhaustive premature requirements. Oracle and intent changes still require maintenance and responsible interpretation.
directions.removal_test: Without the relevant observation the item's claimed verification status loses that support or contradiction, unless another adequate source supplies it. Removing automation while preserving adequate evidence can leave the input intact. Removing the actual requirement consumer leaves ordinary behavior evidence without this P001 relation.
directions.reentry: Changed need, operative version, configuration, oracle, owner decision, credible counterexample or newly established correspondence requires reassessing the affected item; no global baseline restart follows automatically.
directions.finite_control_scope: C24's source identities and equality outcomes are exact finite data. Current requirement authority and user need are explicitly separate premises.

directions.shared_object: The requirement version, expected behavior and status actually used as a regression oracle or coverage claim.
directions.guard: An identified intent item supplies a relevant behavioral criterion, operative/proposed/superseded status or unresolved authority distinction consumed in selecting or interpreting an EA06 check. It need not provide a complete correct specification for every behavior; the local input and its status must be represented honestly.
directions.source_contribution: The actual stated behavior supplies an expected result or scope condition; its status determines whether a check addresses a governing obligation, a proposal/hypothesis or obsolete intent. An explicit unresolved status can qualify the claim without preventing a useful investigation.
directions.receiving_consequence: EA06 can use a meaningful oracle, identify stale coverage, or report a proposed-behavior experiment rather than mislabel it current conformance. The source input constrains the interpretation even if another need, requirement or final approval is still unknown.
directions.remaining_premises: Correctness of the local behavioral criterion and actual need; reliable implementation/observation; authentic object/version correspondence; stakeholder and change authority where applicable; unrepresented interactions. A signed but wrong requirement remains wrong.
directions.positive_witness: C24 distinguishes current R1 support, stale R1 when currentR2 is named, and the sample failure against approvedR2. ProposedR2 is refused as governing while it can still be investigated as a hypothesis. No requirement-complete gate is used to evaluate the known R1 sample.
directions.stronger_claim_counterexample: A stale approved specification drives a green suite after intent changed, or an implementation-derived expected value is passed off as the current requirement. Version/status identification detects this warrant error; it cannot discover whether the declared requirement is actually the right product need.
directions.nontrigger: No relevant intent criterion/status is used by these checks, or the shared artifact is only administrative co-use. Unknown authority does not become settled because the suite passes. A direct owned local example is an adequate realization where its scope is sufficient.
directions.cheap_alternative_and_cost: Use the smallest accessible current example with owner/status/history; retain incomplete needs explicitly and investigate only consequential uncertainty. Avoid a large formal baseline for a low-risk local change. Checking and updating the real oracle still costs effort; document size does not make it credible.
directions.removal_test: Hold observation3 fixed and remove the actual criterion/version: its status as current conformance cannot be inferred from the value alone. An equivalent clearly owned criterion can replace a large requirements artifact. Removing other incomplete requirements does not erase the known local criterion.
directions.reentry: Reopen on legitimate intent revision, supersession, disputed authority, actual-use counterevidence or corrected requirement-to-check mapping; preserve unaffected checks whose premises remain valid.
directions.finite_control_scope: The toy status resolver treats authority as supplied data. It neither discovers real requirements nor grants actual approval.

directions.shared_object: A named consequential behavioral assumption or uncertainty whose supporting evidence and next learning decision actually use regression results.
directions.guard: The P002 inquiry identifies an actual uncertain premise and uses a relevant EA06 observation, counterexample or coverage limitation to update its epistemic state or learning action. Resolving every other uncertainty or choosing the final commitment is not required for a local evidence contribution.
directions.source_contribution: Repeated checks can substantiate or contradict the named behavioral premise at the checked scope, or show that an available portfolio does not answer it. Known failure is evidence even when overall feasibility or user need remains uncertain.
directions.receiving_consequence: The assumption can be narrowed, marked contradicted, assigned another learning method or retained unresolved with a more precise discriminator. Evidence does not mechanically promote it to an agreed requirement or settle an owner decision.
directions.remaining_premises: Actual premise-to-decision relevance, credible oracle and context; representative range; uncertainty outside the checked behavior; decision owner and learning budget. A software behavior sample usually cannot resolve whether an external user wants that behavior.
directions.positive_witness: C24 evaluates proposedR2 as a hypothesis and records sample contradiction while it remains proposed. The upper-risk expected5 hypothesis receives observed8 at the actual finite input, while next_commitment, other_operating_conditions and production_bridge remain unknown. The known local contradiction is not discarded because those other entries are unresolved.
directions.stronger_claim_counterexample: An unknown desired output is replaced with the implementation's actual output and called learned, or a green nominal result is used to retire an unrelated user-need/capacity uncertainty. C24 keeps unknown criteria and wrong evidence scope unresolved.
directions.nontrigger: No actual uncertain premise or dependent learning decision consumes these results. An already demonstrated routine requirement may need no separate uncertainty register; its existing known evidence can still be used where a real uncertainty inquiry exists. Administrative status cycling alone is insufficient.
directions.cheap_alternative_and_cost: Reuse credible existing results or a short assumption note, and choose direct user/domain clarification or analysis when repeated tests cannot discriminate the uncertainty. Avoid indefinite analysis and a large ledger that never affects evidence choice or decisions.
directions.removal_test: Remove the relevant observation and the uncertainty loses that scoped discriminator unless another adequate source replaces it. Remove the dependent uncertainty decision and the same checks may remain useful regression work without supplying P002.
directions.reentry: A changed assumption, decision horizon, representation, oracle, contrary result or more appropriate evidence method reopens the affected learning obligation; it does not make every established requirement tentative.
directions.finite_control_scope: These are explicit finite hypothesis interpretations, not calibrated uncertainty probabilities, causal project evidence or demonstrations that all assumptions are testable.

receiver.selected_criterion: An uncertain premise is distinguished from an agreed requirement, with a proportionate learning action and a decision that depends on the result.

directions.shared_object: A relevant uncertain premise, confidence limit or planned learning condition used to define or interpret regression checking.
directions.guard: Actual uncertainty/assumption reasoning identifies a premise or missing criterion that bears on these checks and is consumed in their scope, oracle or interpretation. The premise need not already be resolved; making its uncertainty explicit can itself change what the check warrants.
directions.source_contribution: The record identifies which behavior is an agreed requirement, a testable hypothesis or an unresolved oracle/context assumption, and what evidence would discriminate it. It can prioritize a relevant check, constrain a green claim, or show that another learning method is needed.
directions.receiving_consequence: EA06 can retain useful known checks while labeling uncertain parts, avoid silently treating speculative outputs as current truth, and seek the actual missing criterion. A full uncertainty register or all-questions-resolved gate is unnecessary.
directions.remaining_premises: Correct relevance and epistemic classification; credible decision owner; attainable discriminating evidence; reliable check implementation and oracle where known. A well-labeled assumption may still be false, and bookkeeping alone generates no new observation.
directions.positive_witness: C24's explicit UNKNOWN expected output yields UNKNOWN_CRITERION instead of false or green. A proposedR2 comparison remains a hypothesis inquiry; an actual R1 criterion can still receive local support while actual_user_need remains unknown.
directions.stronger_claim_counterexample: A large uncertainty ledger lists generic risks but supplies no relevant missing premise or learning discriminator, or treats every settled requirement as tentative indefinitely. It adds no meaningful criterion to the regression work and can defer useful action.
directions.nontrigger: No relevant uncertainty input reaches these checks, or routine stable behavior is already adequately specified and demonstrated. A brief existing assumption/status note may satisfy the actual input without a new risk-register process.
directions.cheap_alternative_and_cost: Mark only consequential unknowns in the existing item and use direct clarification, a valid analytic argument or targeted manual investigation where adequate. Track expiry and ownership without recurring meetings that cannot change the evidence decision.
directions.removal_test: Removing the true unresolved-oracle distinction can make a speculative check look authoritative. An equivalent concise explicit note can replace a formal register. Removing irrelevant uncertainty bookkeeping leaves the warranted checks unchanged.
directions.reentry: New evidence can resolve, contradict or change the assumption and legitimately update the oracle or scope; promotion to governing intent still follows its actual decision route. Reopen on stale assumptions or a mistaken uncertainty classification.
directions.finite_control_scope: C24 makes supplied uncertainty categories explicit; it does not establish psychological safety, ownership adequacy or optimal amounts of uncertainty bookkeeping.

directions.shared_object: A specific behavioral risk hypothesis investigated through executable evidence before a consequential commitment.
directions.guard: An actual P004 risk-retirement inquiry consumes a relevant repeatable EA06 result or check as all or part of its specified executable investigation. The observation addresses a named premise at the represented scope; the whole risk study, representativeness beyond that scope and next commitment may remain unresolved.
directions.source_contribution: A suitable automated check can supply an executable sample or counterexample to the named risk premise and may constitute the cheapest sufficient experiment. It need not be a distinct prototype phase; an ordinary existing check may already provide the relevant evidence.
directions.receiving_consequence: The risk inquiry can reject a failed necessary behavioral assumption, retain scoped support, or identify what the available check does not cover. This changes the warranted evidence/option assessment before a final commit/no-commit decision; it does not prove complete risk retirement or general production suitability.
directions.remaining_premises: An explicit material risk and decision; adequate hypothesis/oracle; correspondence and representativeness for the claimed risk; other conditions and product differences; responsible interpretation and promotion/hardening where applicable. A demo's appearance cannot supply these premises.
directions.positive_witness: In the declared C24 finite risk inquiry, the exact prior C22:r3 upper observation8 contradicts expected5 at input8 while the next commitment and production bridge remain open. One known relevant counterexample is useful now; the control does not require every operating condition or authority to be settled first.
directions.stronger_claim_counterexample: A green ordinary sample at input3 is offered as evidence for the input8 upper condition, or the toy/prototype observation is promoted to an unrelated production artifact. C24 returns the respective scope/correspondence unknown instead of claiming risk retired.
directions.nontrigger: No actual material risk question uses this check, or a routine repeat build needs no new risk-retirement inquiry. Where an existing check already answers a real question, adequacy is a cheap realization rather than a reason to invent a separate prototype.
directions.cheap_alternative_and_cost: Use the smallest sufficiently representative existing check, analysis, manual probe or spike. A separate throwaway prototype costs development and interpretation; productionizing every experiment adds hardening and lock-in costs. New execution is unnecessary when valid current evidence already discriminates the premise.
directions.removal_test: Remove the relevant executable observation and the specified risk premise loses that support or counterexample unless another adequate method supplies it. Remove the actual risk decision and these checks remain ordinary regression work, not automatically P004. Removing a separate prototype is harmless if an existing adequate check already performs the necessary discrimination.
directions.reentry: Reopen when the risk/decision, behavior, environment, configuration, representativeness or promotion assumptions change, or a cheaper sufficient method becomes available. No universal prototype or per-change qualification phase follows.
directions.finite_control_scope: C24 reinterprets actual earlier finite observations for a declared risk question. It is not a new prototype execution, a field experiment or complete qualification.

source.selected_criterion: Maintain proportionate repeatable regression evidence when changing behavior; automate where repeatability and economics justify it.

receiver.selected_criterion: A prototype, pilot, simulation or thin increment answers a specified risk question and changes the next commitment.

directions.shared_object: A concrete behavior, interaction condition, counterexample or scope limit learned by an actual executable risk investigation and consumed by regression work.
directions.guard: A P004 investigation produces a relevant sample, observed failure, condition or representativeness limit that is actually used to design, maintain or interpret an EA06 check. The specific correspondence is stated; complete prototype adequacy, production qualification or final commitment is not a prerequisite to using that partial input.
directions.source_contribution: Executable investigation can reveal a previously omitted input/interaction and supply a reproducible counterexample or representative condition for a future regression check. It can also expose that the available test environment cannot support a claimed production conclusion. A result supplies behavior evidence; the right expected behavior still needs its own justified criterion.
directions.receiving_consequence: EA06 can add the actual failure case, adjust check level/data or narrow a coverage claim, preserving the learned condition through later changes. A prototype's observed output is not automatically the desired output, and its result does not itself approve product promotion.
directions.remaining_premises: Credible experiment and observation; actual relevance of the learned condition; a valid requirement/hypothesis oracle; current target/configuration mapping; repeatability and maintenance cost; evidence needed outside the experiment. Unknown product correspondence limits the transferred claim without erasing the local discovery.
directions.positive_witness: Within the declared finite P004 scenario, the recorded C22:r3 input8/output8 counterexample is compared with the separately stated expected5 criterion. That condition can inform a regression case for the corresponding behavior while commitment and other modes remain unresolved. C24 binds the exact observation and keeps an unestablished production bridge unknown; treating the earlier specimen as a risk-investigation example is an explicit author interpretation.
directions.stronger_claim_counterexample: A polished prototype demo supplies only nominal output, or a test is written to reproduce every observed prototype result including its defect. The former does not cover a new risk condition; the latter can be self-confirming unless desired behavior is independently established.
directions.nontrigger: No actual experiment output or limitation bears on this regression portfolio, or a prototype is retained only as a project label. A directly available adequate failure case or analysis may supply the same input without a separate prototype artifact.
directions.cheap_alternative_and_cost: Retain the smallest useful case and its purpose/configuration/assumptions; derive a targeted regression rather than copying an entire prototype or test environment. Manual evidence, analysis or an existing fixture can be cheaper where adequate. Preserve intended-use and production correspondence work instead of hiding it inside reuse claims.
directions.removal_test: Remove the only relevant learned counterexample and the portfolio can again omit that failure condition. An equivalent known case or analytic argument replaces the discovery input. Remove the demonstrable connection to current regression behavior and the prototype remains informative elsewhere without this relation.
directions.reentry: Reopen for a new experiment, disconfirmed expected behavior, changed target environment/configuration, nonrepeatable case or corrected production mapping. Do not promote every prototype sample into a mandatory permanent regression.
directions.finite_control_scope: The P004 role of the old finite specimen is an explicit author scenario. Only its recorded behavior is actual execution evidence; no real production or user correspondence is inferred.
